scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance in Rent to MSEs
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise run by a SC/ST entrepreneur
The applicant must be a Micro or Small Enterprise (MSE) engaged in manufacturing activities
The enterprise must be operating from a legally rented or leased shed
The shed owner must have legal ownership and possession of the property
The manufacturing unit must be consuming electricity/power for production activities
SC/ST Enterprise is defined as an enterprise where the contribution of a SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to 70% of rent paid by the enterprise, capped at ₹1,00,000 per annum for a period of up to five years.
